page.title: Tihlanganisi
page.intro: Hlanganisa ema-akhawunti akho ekukhangisa. Ema-leads lavela etikhangisweni takho afika ku-My Leads ngekuzenzakalela, ngekucitsa imali kanye netindleko nge-lead ngayinye.

catalog.linkedinDescription: Lead Gen Form liholela ku-Leads Yami, kucitsa imali nsuku tonkhe kanye netindleko ngekuhola ngamunye, kanye nelizinga lekuhola litfunyelwa emuva ku LinkedIn ( Conversions API ).

banner.connected: LinkedIn ixhunyiwe. Kulandvwa ema-leads nyalo - lelikhasi liyabuyeketwa ngesikhashana.
banner.notConfigured: LinkedIn ayikasethwa kuleli seva. Umphatsi kumele engete ID yeklayenti ye-app ye LinkedIn kanye nemfihlo.
banner.expired: Kuxhumana LinkedIn sekuphelelwe sikhatsi, ngako-ke imikhondo ayivumelanisi. Phindza uxhumane kute uchubeke.
banner.reconnectSoon: LinkedIn idzinga kutsi ungene futsi nge {{date}} . Phindza uxhumeke ngaphambi kwaloko kute ugcine imikhondo igeleta.

connect.title: Xhuma LinkedIn
connect.intro: Ngena ngemvume nge-akhawunti LinkedIn lephetse tikhangiso takho. Leadrat ufundza kuphela ema-akhawunti akho esikhangiso, Lead Gen Form kuhola kanye netibalo tesikhangiso, bese utfumela kuguculwa lokuvulako.
connect.need1: Indima ku-akhawunti yesikhangiso se LinkedIn (Umbukeli noma ngetulu).
connect.need2: Indima ekhasini lenkampani lehlanganisiwe (Umphatsi, Lead Gen Forms Manager , Content Admin , Umgcini noma Umhlatiyi) - LinkedIn idzinga kutsi yabelana ngekuhola.
connect.need3: Umbuto wenombolo yelucingo Lead Gen Forms - ema-leads langenayo inombolo yelucingo angeke afakwe.

connection.title: Kuxhumana
connection.autoRenews: Kufinyelela kuyavuselelwa ngekuzenzakalela kuze kube nguleso sikhatsi
connection.syncResult: Kuvumelanisa kwentiwe: {{received}} kutfoliwe, {{created}} kwadalwa, {{duplicates}} kuphindzaphindvwa, {{rejected}} kwaliwa.
connection.confirmDisconnect: Ncamula LinkedIn ? Kuvumelanisa kuyama futsi emathokheni ekufinyelela ayasuswa. Kuhola, tibalo kanye nelogi yemsebenti kuyagcinwa.
connection.noPermission: Ungabuka leli khasi. Kuxhuma nekushintja emasethingi kudzinga imvume ye "Lawula Tilungiselelo".
connection.fetchHint: Ema lead lamasha ayahlolwa njalo ngemuva kwemizuzu lembalwa futsi emalanga langu 7 ekugcina aphindze ahlolwe onkhe malanga, ngako kute lokuphutselwako. Sebentisa loku ku-leads kusukela ngaphambi kwekutsi uxhumeke, noma kuhlola sikhatsi futsi (kuze kube ngemalanga langu-90 ngesikhatsi sinye). Imihola levele ikhona ku Leadrat iyaphulwa.
connection.fetchResult: {{from}} - {{to}} : {{received}} kutfolakele, {{created}} kwadalwa, {{duplicates}} lokuphindvwe kabili, {{rejected}} kwaliwa, {{skipped}} sekuvele kungeniswe.

accounts.title: Ema-akhawunti esikhangiso
accounts.intro: Kuhola kanye netibalo kuvumelaniswa kusuka kuma-akhawunti esikhangiso lavuliwe lapha.
accounts.none: Kute ema-akhawunti esikhangiso latfolakala kule-akhawunti LinkedIn . Hlola indima ye-akhawunti ku LinkedIn Campaign Manager , bese uvuselela.

capi.title: Conversions API
capi.intro: Tjela LinkedIn kutsi nguyiphi imikhondo yayo yaba ematfuba langempela. Uma umholi LinkedIn afinyelela esimeni losikhetsile ngezansi, Leadrat uyabika ku LinkedIn , ngako-ke imibiko yakho yemkhankhaso ikhombisa lizinga lekuhola futsi LinkedIn ingatfola bantfu labanyenti labafana nekuhola kwakho lokuhle kakhulu. Kutfunyelwa kuphela ID yekuhola LinkedIn kanye ne-hash yendlela yinye ye-imeyili.
capi.created: Kuguculwa kwentiwe ku LinkedIn futsi kwabekwa kumephu.

activity.title: Ilogi yemsebenti
activity.intro: Konkhe emkhatsini we Leadrat ne LinkedIn : kuxhumana, konkhe kuvumelanisa, konkhe kuhola kanye naloko lokwenteka kuyo, kuguculwa kanye nemaphutsa.
